_doc: Cursed weapons (Systems/Curses.cs). When a hero takes up a magic weapon from a hoard, chance per mille of the time (by a stable hash) it is cursed with one of these. A cursed weapon cannot be put down, sold or passed on until the curse is lifted (story need cursed, effect curse). Each curse gives and takes: attack, ac, damage and skill are added; brawl multiplies the bearer's chance of starting a tavern brawl; loyalty is added a day (it whispers); heal multiplies their rest in town; jealous bearers can wear no other magic; greedy bearers never sell their loot to the town.

lines.cursed: {hero} takes up the {item}, and it will not let go: it is {curse}. {text}
lines.lifted: The curse on {hero}'s {item} is lifted. It is only a blade now.
lines.broken: {hero}'s cursed {item} is broken on the temple's anvil, and something screams as it goes.

curses.name: bloodthirsty
curses.text: It strikes deep, and drags its bearer into every tavern brawl.

curses.name: jealous
curses.text: It strikes true, but will not share its bearer with any other magic.

curses.name: craven
curses.text: It parries every blow aimed at its bearer, and flinches from striking first.

curses.name: whispering
curses.text: It whispers the secrets of locks and lies, and of better towns than this one.

curses.name: gluttonous
curses.text: It bites deep, and feeds on its bearer while they sleep.

curses.name: miserly
curses.text: It loves gold: its bearer fights harder, and will sell nothing to the town.
